intro: Lebanon's economy was built on banking, trade and tourism, but suffered one of the world's worst financial crises from 2019.

chapters.title: Collapse
text: From 2019 the Lebanese pound lost over 90% of its value, banks froze people's savings, and many people fell into poverty.

chapters.title: Strengths
text: Lebanese wine, food, design and fashion are known worldwide, and money from Lebanese abroad keeps many families going.

keyTerms.meaning: When money suddenly loses much of its value.

cardGroups.title: Made in Lebanon
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Lebanon makes and sells to the world.
